CXCIX. Ego Johannes diclus Borowetz de Rowna tenore presencium notum vniuersis fieri volo et recognosco, quod propter beneficia fauores et amicicias, que religiosi et bonorabiles viri dominus abbas et conuentus monasterii Sanete Corone ordinis Cysterciensis Prag- hensis dyocesis, qui prius fuerunt et adhuc sunt, diuersimode mibi ac pluries exhibuerunt et fecerunt, curiam meam in villa Rowna situatam cum omnibus et singulis, que ad eandem spectant et per tinent, sicuti ego usque in presente m diem ipsam tenui et possedi, et prout in alia liftera plenius continetur, pref'atis domino abbati et conuentui animo deliberato plenarie et ex toto perpetuis temporibus libere tenendam et possidendam tradidi assignaui et condescendi, ita quod am'corum siue heredum meorum penitus nullus inris quic- quam siue iurisdictionis aliquando super eam sibi possit vel debeat vendicare, sed neque vxor mea dotis nomine seu alia quacumque causa expelere uel postulare, condicione quidem tali, quod absque 243 premissis timons et amiciciarum beneficiis ducentas sexagenas grossorum Praghensium pro ipsa mihi dederunt integraliter expe- diendo persoluerunt, nichilominus cousenciendo et promittendo mihi concesserunt, quud supradicta buna usque in vite mee finem debeam et possim adbuc teuere frui et possidere. Insuper et curiam meam in Muscherad, quam ab ipsis hacteuus habui et possedi, cum omnibus, que ad ipsam pertinent, simili modo, sicut de Rowna est expressum et superius iamdictum, reddidi et resignaui. In quorum omnium testimonium sigillo meo neenon et slrennui militis domini Marchwardi de Poressin sigillo presentes litteras feci sigillari. Da tum anno domini millesimo quadringentesimo sexto in festo purifica- cionis beate virgiuis Marie. Über die Siegel siehe die vorhergehende Urkunde. ce. 1406. 4. entries.english:
2 February 1406. The same man repeats his donation with some changes and also renounces his hoof at Muscherad in favor of the said monastery. And Peter von Rosenberg [sells] certain annual rents at Stockernhof and Kirchschlag for 38 score Prague silver groschen.

CXCIX. I, Johannes called Borowetz of Rowna, wish by the tenor of this present letter to make known to all and acknowledge that, because of the benefits, favors and friendship which the religious and honorable men, the abbot and convent of the monastery of the Holy Crown of the Cistercian Order in the Prague diocese, both their predecessors and themselves, have shown and rendered to me in various ways and on many occasions, I have, with deliberate intent, wholly and entirely granted, assigned and surrendered for all time to the aforesaid abbot and convent, to hold and possess freely, my estate situated in the village of Rowna with everything belonging or pertaining to it, as I have held and possessed it until this day and as is more fully set out in another charter. Thus none of my friends or heirs shall ever be able or entitled to claim any right or jurisdiction over it, nor shall my wife be able to evict me or make a claim on account of her dowry or for any other reason. In consideration of the aforesaid benefits and friendship, they have paid me in full 200 score Prague groschen for it; nevertheless, they have permitted and promised me that I may continue to hold, use and possess the aforesaid property until the end of my life. Moreover, I have in like manner returned and surrendered my estate at Muscherad, which I have hitherto held and possessed from them, together with everything belonging to it, as has been stated above concerning Rowna. In witness of all this I have caused this letter to be sealed with my seal and that of the valiant knight Herr Marchward von Poressin. Given in the year of the Lord 1406, on the feast of the Purification of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

For the seals, see the preceding charter.

CE. 4 December 1406. Weclin von Cipin sells to the lords Heinrich and Peter von Rosenberg certain annual rents at Stockernhof and Kirchschlag for 38 score Prague silver groschen.

I, Weclin of Cipin, make known by this letter to all who shall read or hear it that, with deliberate intent and on the counsel of my friends, I have sold to the honorable lords Heinrich and Peter, his son, lords von Rosenberg, and their heirs, my hereditary holdings: at the court of Stokowycz, from Hanzel, seven small groschen; at the mill, likewise five small groschen; at Swyetlik, from two peasant holdings, one score and eight groschen; from Ertl, four and a half score and two pfennigs; and from Peter, the same, together with the full lordship and all pertaining thereto. I sold these for thirty-eight score Prague silver groschen. I have received all this money in full in ready cash from the aforesaid lords, and have transferred the holdings to them as rightful inheritance with full lordship, retaining no right there for myself or my heirs. I and my sureties, Pessyk of Passowar, otherwise of Vzdyczow, and Matieg Wyssny of Wyetrznye, jointly and indivisibly promise to warrant and clear the aforesaid hereditary holdings as the law of the land requires. If we cannot warrant and clear those holdings, we have promised to transfer to them from our own free hereditary properties an equivalent rent and one third more. If we fail to do all as stated above, then one of us, whoever is summoned, must go with one servant and two horses to the town of Krumplow, to the reputable innkeeper indicated to him, and may not leave until we have paid the aforesaid lords the money owed in full and all damages they have suffered through our nonperformance, in ready cash, under the aforesaid lodging obligation. Whoever holds this letter with the good will of the aforesaid lords shall also have full authority as though they themselves held it. As further evidence and confirmation, we have attached our seals to this letter, written in the year of the Lord 1406, on the Saturday before St Nicholas’s Day.

Three small seals, poorly impressed, in white wax. a) A helmet with what may be a man’s bust as its crest; “S. Wezlei Z. Czypina …” b) A helmet with a half-wing; “S. Peski De Wzdiczow.” c) A helmet, perhaps with a half-wing; inscription illegible.
